description: This file defines the SQSAdapterFactory class, which implements the IQueueAdapterFactory interface for creating and managing Amazon SQS-based queue adapters within the Orleans streaming infrastructure. It contains methods for initializing the factory, creating adapters, obtaining cache and queue mapper instances, and handling delivery failure scenarios.

classes.name: SQSAdapterFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating and managing Amazon SQS-based stream adapters in Orleans. It implements methods for adapter creation, cache management, and failure handling.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the factory, setting up the default stream failure handler if not already set.

methods.name: CreateAdapter
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of the SQSAdapter, configured with the provided options and serializer.

methods.name: GetQueueAdapterCache
methods.description: Returns the adapter cache instance used by this factory.

methods.name: GetStreamQueueMapper
methods.description: Returns the stream queue mapper used by this factory.

methods.name: GetDeliveryFailureHandler
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a failure handler for a specified queue.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Static method to instantiate an SQSAdapterFactory given the service provider and factory name.
